briefing: Tech stocks led the market lower today. The NASDAQ fell 1.3% and the S&P 500 fell 0.4%, so the screener returned no candidates. We are holding all 7 positions and keeping the $645.88 in cash. The automatic stop-losses and profit targets still protect each position, and the cash is ready for the next clear risk-on day.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-off day is when investors get nervous and move money out of riskier assets, like fast-growing tech stocks, into safer ones or into cash. You can often spot it when the tech-heavy NASDAQ falls more than the overall market, as it did today. A disciplined investor usually avoids opening new positions on these days and lets existing safety rules, like stop-losses, do their job.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險情緒」（Risk-Off）指投資者轉趨審慎，將資金從高風險資產（例如高增長科技股）撤出，轉投較穩健的資產或持有現金。當以科技股為主的納斯達克跌幅明顯大於大市時，往往就是避險情緒升溫的訊號，正如今日的走勢。紀律嚴謹的投資者通常會在這類日子暫停建立新倉，讓止蝕位等既定風險管理機制自動發揮作用。

market_education.summary_en: Technology and growth stocks drove today's decline: the NASDAQ dropped 1.3% while the broader S&P 500 slipped only 0.4%. When the NASDAQ falls about three times as much as the S&P 500, investors are usually pulling money out of richly valued tech names rather than selling everything. No news headlines were provided for today's session, so we can't point to a specific cause; the move fits a risk-off rotation away from high-momentum stocks.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日跌市由科技及增長股主導，納斯達克指數下挫1.3%，而覆蓋面較廣的標普500指數僅微跌0.4%。納指跌幅約為標普的三倍，反映資金主要從估值偏高的科技股撤出，而非全面拋售。由於今日未有提供相關新聞標題，暫難歸咎於單一消息，但走勢符合資金避險、撤離高動能股份的典型格局。
